title: Two plants, two winners: who approves, and what neither plant could see
why: Each plant chooses for good local reasons. When two plants buy the same material from different vendors, both decisions go to the category manager with the combined picture.

chat.text: Coimbatore chose Kovai: Rs 0.70/kg dearer than Vembanad, but its MOQ is 200 kg against 500 kg, so holding stock costs less. Chennai chose Vembanad: The export customer's audit requires ISO 22716, and only Vembanad holds it. Together the plants buy 7,924 kg a year, above Vembanad's 6,000 kg group tier, worth 4% off. If Coimbatore also moved to Vembanad, the group would save about Rs 36,134 a year.
detail: Options: approve both as decided, or ask Coimbatore to move.

chat.text: Ask Coimbatore whether it can move to Vembanad.
Kovai is our current glycerin supplier, on time 95% of the time and two hours away. We don't want to switch during the February launch. We can move after March.
Coimbatore declined, with a reason. Suggested: Approve both for now. Re-quote glycerin with Vembanad at the combined volume once Coimbatore can switch.
